short_description: Leica FlexLine TS07 2" R500 manual total station: 500 m reflectorless, 3,500 m to prism, 30x telescope, FlexField touchscreen, IP66, 30 h battery.
long_description:
## What it is

The Leica FlexLine TS07 is a manual total station from Leica Geosystems' FlexLine range, supplied here in the 2-second angular accuracy, R500 reflectorless configuration. Angles are read with 0.1" display resolution and held by a quadruple-axis compensator with a +/- 4' working range and 0.5" setting accuracy; distances come from a coaxial visible red-laser PinPoint EDM rated Class 3R under IEC 60825-1:2014. The instrument runs Leica FlexField software on a 3.5-inch 320 x 240 colour touchscreen with a 28-key illuminated keypad and a user-definable trigger key, and weighs about 4.3 kg.

## What it's for

It is built for building construction, civil engineering and survey-and-mapping work: control traverses, topographic pick-up, plot demarcation and, above all, setting out on site. Endless horizontal and vertical drives with drives on both sides make repetitive stakeout quicker, and the optional AutoHeight module measures the instrument height automatically so that one common setup error disappears.

## Key specifications

To a single prism the EDM is accurate to 1 mm + 1.5 ppm, with a 3,500 m range to a GPR1 round prism and a long-range mode beyond 10,000 m. Without a prism it reaches 500 m on a 90% reflective surface, at 2 mm + 2 ppm up to 500 m and 4 mm + 2 ppm beyond. The 30x telescope has a 1°30' field of view (2.7 m at 100 m), 3" resolving power and focuses from 1.5 m. Data lives on 2 GB of internal flash, an SD card or a USB stick and leaves through RS232, USB or Bluetooth, with WLAN and an LTE side cover as options. The GEB361 Li-ion battery gives up to 30 hours of measuring. The housing is sealed to IP66, rated from -20 °C to +50 °C and rain-tested to MIL-STD-810G.

## Field notes

The Class 2 laser plummet holds 1.5 mm at 1.5 m instrument height; level on the 6'/2 mm circular bubble and refine on the 2" electronic level. Run the FlexField check-and-adjust routine after transport or a large temperature change, keep the 5/8-inch tripod screw tight, and respect the IP66 limit - the instrument shrugs off monsoon rain and dust but not immersion. The Indian dealer warranty is 12 months and extended warranty packages are available.

## What's in the case

TS07 instrument, GEB361 Li-ion battery with charger, tribrach, USB cable, adjustment tools, rain cover, user manual and the hard transport container. A calibration certificate is normally supplied with a new instrument.
